newsitem.title: UK: Copper mine output to rise 10 pct in 1996 - IWCC.
newsitem.headline: Copper mine output to rise 10 pct in 1996 - IWCC.

text.p: Copper mine production in the Western world, including Hungary and Poland, is seen rising by 10 percent this year to 9.366 million tonnes, the International Wrought Copper Council (IWCC) said.
In its annual report (1995/96) the IWCC said output will rise a further four percent on 1997, with the majority of the growth in South America and Australia.
In the CIS, China, and other countries, production this year and in 1997 should be stable at 1995 levels of 1.462 million tonnes, it added.
Refined production in the West for 1996 and 1997 is put at 10.645 and 11.205 million tonnes.
Consumption this year will be virtually unchanged at 10.541 million tonnes, rising by a modest two percent in 1997 to 10.923 million tonnes, the IWCC added.
